project.snapshot() #1
ShowMessageBox("Apply Arrangement", 0) -> 1 <<
This project's tempo/time-signature envelope is on a Beats timebase, and a Repack cannot move tempo markers reliably while it is.

Every tempo marker holds its bar position and REAPER works out its time from the markers before it, so moving one marker silently moves all the later ones -- a real run drifted by 1.121s and stopped partway through.

Fix: Project Settings -> "Timebase for tempo/time signature env" -> Time. Save the project, then run this again.

(This is read from the saved .RPP. If you just changed it, save first.)
>>
